name: slack
description: Send and read messages in Slack workspaces. Supports posting to channels, reading conversation history, and looking up users and channels via the Slack API.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token (starts with xoxb-). Create a Slack app and install it to your workspace to obtain one.

SLACK_TEAM_ID.description: The ID of your Slack workspace (e.g. T01234567). Found in your workspace URL or admin settings.
